model.name: WebItem mint bypasses the class — drop-dispatcher pseudo-fallback (url.split.pop) names a valid URL badly + skips url-validation; the class must own name + validation at mint
model.description: LIVE (architect full-path execution + expert reproduce, decisive measurement): drop-dispatcher.ts:133 sets name = displayName || url.split(SLASH).pop() || link, so a valid YouTube URL with no human displayName is named "watch?v=X"; deriveName (WebItem.ts:46) returns the fallback VERBATIM = the class name derivation never runs. A VALID url gets a BAD name = a live violation of R40.105 (class owns its name). Plus (PO robustness): the mint does not validate/normalize the url, so a domain-less/invalid input mints a broken hostless WebItem. FIX (expert-proposed, architect-backed): drop the url.split.pop pseudo-fallback so the WebItem CLASS derives its own name when no human displayName, AND validate/normalize the url at mint. Fix WHERE THE OBJECT IS MADE = closes the class regardless of source (the shape Tron keeps demanding). The 4 restore WebItems on Bug 88df8e4e are re-derived by this fix.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A URL drop with NO human displayName -> the NAME comes from the CLASS (deriveName host+seg), NOT a caller URL-fragment. EXECUTED proof: deriveName(youtubeURL, undefined)="Youtube Watch" vs bug deriveName(youtubeURL, "watch?v=X")="watch?v=X".

gateRef.assertion: drop a YouTube URL (no displayName) -> name = "Youtube Watch" (class-derived); a url-fragment name => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a valid YouTube URL drop named "watch?v=X" -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: grep 0 URL-fragment name PRE-derivation in ANY url-drop caller (drop-dispatcher.ts:133 url.split.pop REMOVED); the class owns naming (R40.105).

gateRef.assertion: 0 callers name a WebItem from a url fragment before the class derives; any url.split.pop name-fallback => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a caller naming from url.split.pop -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: A genuine HUMAN displayName (e.g. v0.6.90 email subject) is STILL used -> deriveName returns it. Dropping the pseudo-fallback must NOT drop the real human-name path.

gateRef.assertion: drop with displayName "My Video" -> name = "My Video"; a lost human displayName => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a drop with a real displayName that is ignored -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: A hostless/domain-less url is REJECTED or RECONSTRUCTED at mint -> no unopenable/hostless WebItem persisted.

gateRef.assertion: mint url="watch?v=X" (no host) -> rejected or normalized, not stored raw; a hostless WebItem persisted => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed mint of a hostless/domain-less url -> a raw broken WebItem stored => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: PO RULED (un-gated): RE-DERIVE 3, PROTECT 1. RE-DERIVE names (ANNOUNCED) for the 3 BUG-generated fragments -> the class deriveName(url): adf1a8c0 (watch?v=D6XhtIfNiyo), cf45d317 (message:%3C...), dc48165b (watch?v=On8AxkeHYNE). PROTECT (do NOT rename) 96f54cc2 "jonah.jala@indigitous.org Indigitous Hack26" - that name came from a REAL email-subject displayName (human-supplied via the correct path) = USER INTENT, the no-auto-rename ban protects it (renaming it = us "improving" a human-chosen name). ANNOUNCED not silent: the 3 re-derives are surfaced on the row + to Tron (he learns 3 came back with corrected names + why; can re-rename if he disagrees).

gateRef.assertion: exactly the 3 bug-fragments (adf1a8c0/cf45d317/dc48165b) get class-derived names; 96f54cc2 name UNCHANGED; all 4 restored to room 3231db71 fileUnits; 3f80f8c8 junk deleted. A bug-fragment not re-derived, OR 96f54cc2 renamed, OR a 4th unit renamed => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed: 96f54cc2 (human name) re-derived/renamed -> RED; a bug-fragment (adf1a8c0/cf45d317/dc48165b) kept with its watch?v= name -> RED; a re-derive applied silently (not announced) -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: [HONEST-UNVERIFIED, HARNESS gap - NOT a Tron-test]: the iOS YouTube share-sheet payload shape is UNTESTED (captured-payload check). The mint-level fix is source-AGNOSTIC so it closes the class BY CONSTRUCTION pending the captured-payload confirm. certScope: closed-by-construction; iOS-share-payload-capture PENDING.
